definition: Caption is a heading required on all pleadings (court documents) submitted to the court. The caption or title of a pleading is the heading or introductory clause which shows the name, address, telephone number of the attorney, the name of the parties, the name of the court, the county where the action is bought, and usually the term of the court and the number of the case on the docket or calendar. Each jurisdiction has its own set of rules regarding the format of the caption. For example, as per Rule 10(a) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, every pleading must have a caption with the court’s name, a title, a file number, and a Rule 7(a) designation.
